div.div:
Solid = request/data path · Dashed = auth / control path.
ALB: 403 without the CloudFront origin-verify header; security group admits CloudFront edge nodes only. Every /api/* call requires a Cognito JWT (write APIs: admin role).
Pull is the primary path: connectors read AgentCore, Guardrails and CloudWatch with the read-only task role. Push (Lambda translator) is optional, for near-real-time runs.
Cross-account spokes (not drawn): the task role assumes agent-lineage-readonly in each spoke account, guarded by a per-deployment ExternalId.
